tasks.sql:
WITH rpt_contacts AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.account_contact_id, src.first_name, src.last_name, src.full_name, src.contact_email, src.contact_phone, src.company_id, src.company_name, src.location_id, src.owner_user_id, src.owner_name, src.lead_source, src.lead_status, src.disqualify_reason, src.bant_budget, src.bant_authority, src.bant_need, src.bant_timeline, src.converted_deal_id, src.crm_status, src.is_active, src.marketing_opt_out, src.created_at, src.updated_at FROM (
SELECT 
  cp.id,
  cp.organization_id,
  cp.account_contact_id,
  cdp.first_name,
  cdp.last_name,
  cdp.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(cdp.last_name, '') AS full_name,
  id_k.key_value AS contact_email,
  id_p.key_value AS contact_phone,
  cp.company_id,
  c.name AS company_name,
  cp.location_id,
  cp.owner_user_id,
  su.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(su.last_name, '') AS owner_name,
  cp.lead_source,
  cp.lead_status,
  cp.disqualify_reason,
  cp.bant_budget,
  cp.bant_authority,
  cp.bant_need,
  cp.bant_timeline,
  cp.converted_deal_id,
  cp.crm_status,
  (cp.crm_status = 'active') AS is_active,
  cp.marketing_opt_out,
  cp.created_at,
  cp.updated_at
FROM crm.contact_profiles cp
LEFT JOIN cdp.customer_profile cdp ON cdp.cdp_id = cp.account_contact_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ik.key_value 
  FROM cdp.identity_keys ik 
  WHERE ik.cdp_id = cp.account_contact_id AND ik.key_type = 'email' AND ik.organization_id = cp.organization_id 
  ORDER BY ik.created_at ASC 
  LIMIT 1
) id_k ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ik.key_value 
  FROM cdp.identity_keys ik 
  WHERE ik.cdp_id = cp.account_contact_id AND ik.key_type = 'phone' AND ik.organization_id = cp.organization_id 
  ORDER BY ik.created_at ASC 
  LIMIT 1
) id_p ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN crm.companies c ON c.id = cp.company_id AND c.organization_id = cp.organization_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.setup_users su ON su.id = cp.owner_user_id
WHERE cp.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT owner_name, COUNT(*) AS lead_count FROM rpt_contacts AS contacts WHERE lead_status = 'contacted' GROUP BY owner_name LIMIT 500
